# Project & deliverable {.unnumbered}

```{r}
#| label: load-packages
#| include: FALSE
library(tibble)
library(flextable)
library(officer)
```


```{r}
#| tbl-cap: "Project data"

sh_website <- "https://mission-soil-platform.ec.europa.eu/index.php/project-hub/soilharmony"

darkbrown <- rgb(124, 94, 57, maxColorValue = 250)

project_data <- tribble(
  ~ "V1",            ~ "V2",
  "Project acronym", "SOILHARMONY",
  "Project name", paste0("Towards a Harmonised pan-European Monitoring",
                         "of Soil Health Descriptors"),
  "Project number",  "101296615",
  "Call topic",      "HORIZON-MISS-2025-05-SOIL-04",
  "Type of action",  "HORIZON-RIA",
  "Lead contractor", "INRAE",
  "Project website", sh_website
)
flextable(project_data) |>
  autofit() |>
  delete_part(part = "header") |>
  style(
    j = 1,
    pr_c = fp_cell(background.color = darkbrown),
    pr_t = fp_text(color = "white")
  ) |>
  theme_box()
```

```{r}
#| tbl-cap: "Deliverable data"

deliverable_data <- tribble(
  ~ "V1",                ~ "V2",
  "Name/title",          "SoilHarmony Statistical Analysis Plan",
  "Deliverable no.",     "D5.1",
  "Description",         "Statistical Analysis Plan (StAP)",
  "Type",                "??",
  "Dissemination level", "??",
  "Due date",            "M12 (June 2027)",
  "Submission date",     "??",
  "Work package no.",    "WP5",
  "Lead beneficiary",    "EVINBO / CRA-W / ATK",
  "Version",             "",
  "Author(s)",           ""
)

flextable(deliverable_data) |>
  autofit() |>
  delete_part(part = "header") |>
  style(
    j = 1,
    pr_c = fp_cell(background.color = darkbrown),
    pr_t = fp_text(color = "white")
  ) |>
  theme_box()
```

\newpage

```{r}
#| tbl-cap: "Contributors"

inbo <- "Research Institute Nature and Forest, Flanders (Belgium)"

contributors <- tribble(
  ~ "Name",         ~ "Organization and country",
  "Hans Van Calster", inbo,
  "Ben Serrien",      inbo,
)

flextable(contributors) |>
  autofit() |>
  theme_box() |>
  bg(bg = darkbrown, part = "header") |>
  color(color = "white", part = "header")
```


```{r}
#| tbl-cap: "Revision history"

revision_history <- tribble(
  ~ "Version", ~ "Date",     ~ "Reviewer", ~ "Modifications",
  "V0",        "2026-09-07", "/",          "initial setup quarto-book"
)

flextable(revision_history) |>
  autofit() |>
  theme_box() |>
  bg(bg = darkbrown, part = "header") |>
  color(color = "white", part = "header")
```
